name: Remove Tooltip Delay and Lockout
creator: moga
description:
### Overview:
[Slightly transparent tooltips mod to look like the thumbnail](https://runeforge.dev/mods/a13cfe1c-ef1f-4410-9d7b-a0aaafbff741)
* Without this mod on, you'll notice that after not hovering a tooltip for about a third of a second, your tooltip will basically [go on cooldown.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8ij2Wgxb67Q) This means that once you re-hover something after you trigger the lockout, you have to wait another ~0.3 seconds for the tooltip to trigger again.
**This is VERY annoying and this mod removes that delay entirely.**

Please report bugs. (there are none, the mod just breaks on new patches lol)
